evidence: Job completion now requires deliverable + test + evidence + metric where applicable.

lesson: Media claims create hypotheses, not strategy.
Syntax PASS is not runtime PASS; collection selectors must be validated as runtime contracts.
evidence: Active Operations had two DOM collection-selector defects. A first stricter regression test exposed the issue, the test itself was corrected to avoid false positives, literal $$ selectors were applied, and Core v2 CI run 35489524884 passed. Root/deployed mirror contract later passed in run 35489720660.

lesson: Security exceptions should be capability-specific, not broad workflow bypasses.
evidence: Owner Gate previously failed on approved GitHub Pages writes, GitHub-hosted validation artifacts and localhost smoke-test curl. The gate was changed to allow only named Pages permissions/actions, named upload-artifact workflows and curl to 127.0.0.1. Owner Gate run 35489587956 passed while non-allowlisted outbound/write patterns remain blocked.

lesson: One public URL should have one coherent artifact contract even when multiple deployment paths exist.
evidence: LIFF Pages workflow was narrowed from tests/** to tests/static-contract.test.mjs; AGIS deploy was republished; root Active Operations HTML/CSS/JS/roster were mirrored to Core v2.1; mirror contract passed in 35489720660 and dynamic Pages deployment 35489720000 succeeded.

lesson: Visual Agent motion must be driven by recorded state and must never be used as evidence that work occurred.
evidence: Active Operations v2.2 uses the existing pixel engine for 12 Core Agent sprites. READY agents patrol/available; WORKING/REVIEW/LEARNING agents use active workstation animation; BLOCKED agents wait at Blocker Bay. Core v2 contract 35490073038 and AGIS deploy 35490066706 passed.

lesson: A management-RPG operations view becomes more truthful and readable when room occupancy, path lanes and collision handling are derived from the same recorded Agent state.
evidence: AGIS-12 v3.1 added a live minimap, 9 clickable rooms, room status aggregation, per-Agent selection HUD, three corridor lanes and local collision separation. Core ship contract 35584258765, CI 35584258574 and Pages 35584257451 all passed.
